newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial completes share offering.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial completes share offering.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said it completed a public offering of 700,000 shares of its common stock at a price of $43.375 a share.
The offering was underwritten by Piper Jaffray Inc. and Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Inc.

TCF said the offering met one of the criteria to allow its pending merger with Winthrop Resources Corp to be accounted for as a pooling of interests. Under the merger agreement, TCF was required to complete the sale of shares prior to consummation of the merger.

Net proceeds will be used to pay a portion of the cash due in the previously announced proposed merger of a subsidiary of TCF with Standard Financial Inc. If the merger with Standard did not occur, proceeds would be used for working capital and for general corporate purposes, TCF said.

In added that, on June 2, the Federal Reserve Board approved TCF's proposed acquisition of Winthrop. The merger is subject to approval by TCF and Winthrop shareholders at special meetings on June 24, and certain other conditions.
Assuming approval, the merger is expected to close on or shortly after June 24, said TCF, a national bank holding company based in Minneapolis with $7 billion in assets.
